arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_spent_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Sums the amount of every transaction made on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000, and shows the total in dollars.
assumptions: 'Spent' means the sum of all transaction amounts on those cards, including the 56,900 transactions with negative amounts, whose meaning is undocumented and which are not treated as refunds.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, covering the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
